description: Reorders a single prompt's dynamic mid-turn tokens after static prefix tokens to prevent 1.25x cold-cache invalidation and restore 0.1x warm cache reads. Advisory in-memory simulation that mutates no live prompts and requires no authentication; zero-token inputs return 0 USD cost without error. Sums static_prefix_tokens and dynamic_mid_tokens to compare before_layout_cost_usd against after_layout_cost_usd and net_savings_pct (0-100). Use this tool when diagnosing mid-prompt timestamps or tool outputs that break cache breakpoints; use pin_single_model_prefix_cache instead to project 10-turn session economics for a target model ID.

completion_tokens.description: Output completion token count for the turn.

dynamic_mid_tokens.description: Token count of volatile per-turn context that invalidates downstream cache breakpoints.

static_prefix_tokens.description: Token count of invariant system instructions and repository context.

name: optimize_prompt_cache_layout
